subject: CloudEdge packaging and discount exception request — 3yr committed Dedicated
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CloudEdge — 3yr packaging discount request / approval needed

Hi Marissa / Marcus,

Quick summary: CloudEdge (SaaS infra vendor) is asking for a 35% off-list discount on our Dedicated 3-year packaged offering in return for a fully committed, prepaid contract and a 3x expansion option in year 2. Net-new ARR would be ~$1.2M ARR in year 1 (prepaid), with a forecast of $3.6M ARR over three years if they take expansion.

They've flagged two requirements that push outside standard policy:
- A deep upfront discount (requested 35% off published Dedicated rates)
- Explicit SLO exceptions for 99.5% p95 latency on heavy KV cache workloads

Why I'm escalating: our standard max approval at AE/manager level is 25% for multi-year packages. This request needs a formal exception memo for VP/CFO sign-off (and legal redlines for SLO language). I ran a simple revenue/margin scenario and attached the pricing spreadsheet + MAP.

Asks:
1) Can finance/CFO sign off on a 35% exception if we get a full prepay + minimum spend guarantee in Q1?
2) If not, what's the cap we can offer quickly (30% + usage credits / or 25% + tiered true-ups)?
3) Legal — are we comfortable with a narrow SLO carveout and a termination right tied to performance?

Attachments: CloudEdge_Mutual_Action_Plan_v2.xlsx, pricing-scenario-analysis-CE-468.csv, draft memo.

I'll prepare a 1-page exception memo if you want a concise packet for Laura. Need quick turn — CloudEdge expects an answer by Mon EOD PT.

Thanks,
Connor
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

---
(attachment stubs: CloudEdge_Mutual_Action_Plan_v2.xlsx [XLSX], pricing-scenario-analysis-CE-468.csv [CSV], discount-exception-memo-draft.pdf [PDF])

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 10:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudEdge — 3yr packaging discount request / approval needed

Thanks for the summary, Connor.

A few quick points:
- We need a one-page finance memo (NPV at our blended gross margin, show payback and downside) — send me the numbers by EOB today.
- 35% is outside what I'll sign off on; I'd be comfortable taking 30% to Laura with the right offsets (prepay, minimum quarterly commit, and a 1-year usage true-up).
- Legal needs to draft the SLO exemption text and add a rollback clause if we hit resource overrun. CC Legal and Laura here.

If Laura agrees to 30% with those protections, we can accept. If she wants stricter protections we should counter 25% + escalation credits.

Please attach the one-pager and highlight the "must-haves" (prepay amount, minimum quarterly, SLO rollback). I'll prep a short note to Laura recommending approval at 30% contingent on legal signoff.

Marissa
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

On the finance memo: include baseline ARR, gross margin assumptions (use 58% blended for Dedicated after GPU costs), and worst-case churn scenario.

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Legal Team <legal_team@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 11:40:57 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudEdge — 3yr packaging discount request / approval needed

Marissa — attached updated pricing analysis and a short exception memo draft (first pass). Highlights:
- List price (3yr Dedicated package): $1,840,000 total cash (annualized $613k).
- Customer requested 35% -> proposed 30% counter if we receive full prepay for year 1 and a guarantee of 80% of forecasted usage in Q1-Y1.
- Blended gross margin at 30% discount with prepay: ~52%. NPV (discount 10% annual) still positive; payback within 8 months given prepay.
- Risk: if they underconsume below 65% of forecast, margin falls below 30% — recommend a quarterly true-up with minimum spend clawback.

I've made two recommendation paths in the memo:
A) Approve 30% + prepay + quarterly minimums + SLO carveout + legal CL.
B) Approve 25% + staged volume credits (better margin protection).

Please see pricing-scenario-analysis-CE-468.csv and discount-exception-memo-draft.pdf attached. Legal: please propose concise SLO language that (a) limits exposure to defined workload patterns and (b) includes an engineering remediation schedule + termination right if service impact persists.

Connor
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

(attachment stubs: pricing-scenario-analysis-CE-468.csv [CSV], discount-exception-memo-draft.pdf [PDF])

> On Fri, May 22, 2026 at 09:12 Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai> wrote:
> > Quick summary: CloudEdge (SaaS infra vendor) is asking for a 35% off-list discount...

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Legal Team <legal_team@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 16:20:33 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudEdge — 3yr packaging discount request / approval needed

Connor / Marissa / team —

Reviewing the memo and the numbers: I can provide conditional CFO approval for a discount exception, subject to these firm conditions:
1) Final offer capped at 30% (no approval for 35%).
2) Customer must prepay year 1 in full and sign minimum quarterly spend guarantees (we want at least 75% of forecast in Q1).
3) Legal-approved SLO carveout with an explicit engineering remediation timeline (30/60/90 days) and automatic rollback to standard pricing if remediation fails.
4) Include a clawback clause for underconsumption that preserves minimum margin (clawback triggers if usage < 65% of forecast in any rolling quarter).
5) Deal to be routed through procurement with DocuSign executed by both sides before the end of next month.

If legal confirms the SLO language and procurement confirms the DocuSign path, I will sign off on a 30% exception. Please prepare a 1-page exec memo (to Laura) summarizing these conditions and attach the legal language.

Laura Bennett
Chief Financial Officer
Redwood Inference

---
(On margin: the blended margin assumption used is reasonable; I want clarity on the true hardware op-ex assumptions in the spreadsheet before final signature.)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Legal Team <legal_team@redwood.ai>, Alyssa Chan <alyssa.chan@cloudedge.com>, Tom Yates <tom.yates@cloudedge.com>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 17:10:05 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudEdge — 3yr packaging discount request / approval needed

Laura — thanks, that's straightforward and helpful. We'll proceed with the conditional path:
- I'll update the exception memo to list the 5 conditions you specified and circulate to Legal for SLO language.
- We'll push for full year-1 prepay and Q1 minimums in the MAP; procurement at CloudEdge is already signaling interest in a DocuSign flow.
- Marcus / Rishi: can you confirm we have the integration and SRE resources to commit to the 30/60/90 remediation windows?

Alyssa / Tom (CloudEdge) — appreciate your patience. We'll get a formal counter to you early next week (Mon AM PT) with the conditional 30% path and the legal SLO language for review.

Connor
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

(Next steps: Connor to produce final 1-page memo, Legal to draft SLO carveout, Procurement + CloudEdge to confirm DocuSign timeline.)
